Author: Arty
Name: RollTracker
TestingChangelog: UI rework changelog display update: the in-plugin changelog is now split into proper sections and bullets. Includes the full UI rework notes for layouts, themes, Truth or Dare rounds, Roll History, ToD Suggestions, Special Rules, Command Help, Chat Alias, Advanced Mode, Shell Infos, Settings, Changelog Window, and Defaults/Migration.
Description:
Reads chat messages, detects /random rolls, tracks Truth or Dare rounds, and provides configurable !truth, !dare, !help, !tod2, and !wifi helpers.

Commands:
/rt - open or close the window.
/rt help - show the full command and trigger list locally.
Punchline: Tracks /random rolls for private round games.
